ProtocolId.description: New public protocol reference, not the domain entity primary key

BigintId.description: Canonical positive decimal; runtime BigInt validation must enforce PostgreSQL max 9223372036854775807

DomainUuid.description: UUID resource identity; actual resource decides representation

CatalogVersion.description: Opaque version of structural tool contracts; not an availability observation

model_id.description: Configured/discovered exact model, no default or static model enum; application additionally caps UTF-8 bytes at1024

anyOf.description: Exact optional provider-defined effort identifier; no universal level or default.

timezone.description: IANA of source calendar, validated at runtime

query.description: Bounded Unicode query; Server also validates at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

term.description: Bounded Unicode query; Server also validates at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

EntityCandidates.description: unique requires exactly one matching candidate across the complete authorized search and next_cursor null; a partial page cannot prove uniqueness. Server validates candidate resource identity and arithmetic ID bounds.

Sequence.description: Positive bigint sequence. Server validates bigint range and conversation/cursor membership.

Cursor.description: Opaque cursor controlled by Server, validated against route, scope, sort and filters. Admission length is bounded by AI-04 policy.

UtcInstant.description: Server instant in UTC, not a civil domain date.

PageLimit.description: Normalized transport integer; effective maximum comes from validated admission policy, not a provider quota.

ReviewValue.description: Scalars retain original representation. Structured projections/edits use tagged arrays/ordered field entries; registered domain fields and value schemas are validated by Server.

direction.description: Default forward preserves existing cursors; backward returns a latest window, chronologically ordered, with a cursor toward older messages.

has_more.description: More rows remain after the scanned checkpoint. next_cursor is an observer checkpoint, including at the tail.

AttachmentUploadMetadata.description: Multipart metadata part, separated from binary file field. Format/bytes/counts and ownership are enforced by AI-04/32 before costly parsing.

CapabilitySchemas.description: Resolved JSON Schema documents from verified registry only. Meta-schema validity alone does NOT prove strictness, authorization, safe refs or per-domain coverage; Server enforces all publication gates.

model_id.description: Configured/discovered exact model, no default or static model enum; application additionally caps UTF-8 bytes at1024

anyOf.description: Exact optional provider-defined effort identifier; no universal level or default.

model_id.description: Configured/discovered exact model, no default or static model enum; application additionally caps UTF-8 bytes at1024

anyOf.description: Exact optional provider-defined effort identifier; no universal level or default.

ConfirmationToken.description: Canonical random32-byte base64url opaque challenge; human channel only, never model/cache/logs

operation.description: Historical receipt kind may include removed Web logout; no current tool or writable mode is enabled by this receipt.

model_id.description: Configured/discovered exact model, no default or static model enum; application additionally caps UTF-8 bytes at1024

anyOf.description: Exact optional provider-defined effort identifier; no universal level or default.

HistoricalRunSelection.description: Read-only run provenance; retired means a removed historical mode and never authorizes execution.

HistoricalRunRoutingSnapshot.description: Read-only historical routing provenance; does not enable delegation on new turns.
